title: Narendra Modi — Prime Minister of India
answer: Narendra Modi is 75 years old (born 17 September 1950 in Vadnagar, Gujarat). He has been serving as the 14th Prime Minister of India since May 2014.
highlights: Current Age: 75 years old (Born 17 September 1950 in Vadnagar, Gujarat)
Office: 14th Prime Minister of India (2014 – Present)
Previous Office: Chief Minister of Gujarat (2001 – 2014)
Political Party: Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)

title: Rahul Gandhi — Leader of the Opposition (Lok Sabha)
answer: Rahul Gandhi is 56 years old (born 19 June 1970 in New Delhi). He is an Indian politician and currently serves as the Leader of the Opposition in the 18th Lok Sabha.
highlights: Current Age: 56 years old (Born 19 June 1970 in New Delhi)
Current Office: Leader of the Opposition in Lok Sabha (since June 2024)
Constituency: Member of Parliament for Rae Bareli (previously Wayanad and Amethi)
Political Party: Indian National Congress (INC)

title: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam — 11th President of India & Missile Man
answer: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam (15 October 1931 – 27 July 2015) was an Indian aerospace scientist and statesman who served as the 11th President of India from 2002 to 2007. Known as the Missile Man of India.
highlights: Lifespan: 15 October 1931 – 27 July 2015 (Aged 83)
Known As: Missile Man of India & People's President
Major Projects: Integrated Guided Missile Development Programme (Agni & Prithvi), Pokhran-II nuclear tests
Highest Civilian Honor: Bharat Ratna (1997)

title: Mahatma Gandhi — Father of the Indian Nation
answer: Mahatma Gandhi (Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi; 2 October 1869 – 30 January 1948) was an Indian lawyer, anti-colonial nationalist, and political ethicist who led the successful campaign for India's independence from British rule using nonviolent resistance (Satyagraha).
highlights: Lifespan: 2 October 1869 (Porbandar, Gujarat) – 30 January 1948 (New Delhi)
Title: Father of the Nation (Rashtrapita), Mahatma (Great Soul)
Key Movements: Non-Cooperation Movement (1920), Dandi Salt March (1930), Quit India Movement (1942)
International Day of Non-Violence: Celebrated globally on 2 October (his birthday)

title: Shaheed Bhagat Singh — Indian Revolutionary Freedom Fighter
answer: Bhagat Singh (28 September 1907 – 23 March 1931) was a charismatic Indian revolutionary freedom fighter who sacrificed his life at the age of 23 for India's independence from British colonial rule.
highlights: Lifespan: 28 September 1907 (Banga, Punjab) – 23 March 1931 (Lahore Jail, Aged 23)
Organization: Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA)
Famous Actions: Central Legislative Assembly bombing (1929), Saunders assassination
Popular Slogan: Inquilab Zindabad (Long Live the Revolution)

keywords: give me blood and i will give you freedom
title: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose — Nationalist Leader & Commander of INA
answer: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose (23 January 1897 – 18 August 1945) was a prominent Indian nationalist leader who led the Indian National Army (Azad Hind Fauj) to overthrow British rule in India.
highlights: Lifespan: 23 January 1897 (Cuttack, Odisha) – 18 August 1945
Leadership: Supreme Commander of the Indian National Army (INA / Azad Hind Fauj)
Parakram Diwas: Celebrated annually in India on 23 January to honor his courage
Famous Slogans: 'Jai Hind' and 'Give me blood, and I shall give you freedom!'

title: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar — Father of the Indian Constitution
answer: Dr. Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar (14 April 1891 – 6 December 1956) was an Indian jurist, economist, social reformer, and political leader who served as the Chairman of the Constitution Drafting Committee and India's first Minister of Law and Justice.
highlights: Lifespan: 14 April 1891 (Mhow, MP) – 6 December 1956 (New Delhi, Aged 65)
Key Role: Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Constitution of India
Offices: First Minister of Law and Justice of Independent India
Highest Civilian Honor: Bharat Ratna (Posthumously awarded in 1990)

title: Albert Einstein — Theoretical Physicist & Father of Modern Physics
answer: Albert Einstein (14 March 1879 – 18 April 1955) was a German-born theoretical physicist widely acknowledged as one of the greatest physicists in history, best known for developing the Theory of Relativity and the mass-energy equivalence formula E = mc².
highlights: Lifespan: 14 March 1879 (Ulm, Germany) – 18 April 1955 (Princeton, NJ, USA, Aged 76)
Major Discoveries: General & Special Relativity, Photoelectric Effect, Mass-Energy Equivalence (E = mc²)
Nobel Prize: 1921 Nobel Prize in Physics for his explanation of the Photoelectric Effect
Impact: Revolutionized the scientific understanding of space, time, gravity, and quantum mechanics

title: Sir Isaac Newton — Polymath & Classical Physics Pioneer
answer: Sir Isaac Newton (4 January 1643 – 31 March 1727) was an English mathematician, physicist, astronomer, and author who established classical mechanics, formulated the Three Laws of Motion and Universal Gravitation, and co-invented infinitesimal calculus.
highlights: Lifespan: 4 January 1643 (Woolsthorpe, England) – 31 March 1727 (London, Aged 84)
Masterpiece: Philosophiæ Naturalis Principia Mathematica (1687)
Key Formulations: Laws of Motion, Law of Universal Gravitation, Calculus, Optics & Refracting Telescope
Burial Site: Westminster Abbey, London

title: Nikola Tesla — Electrical Engineer & AC Pioneer
answer: Nikola Tesla (10 July 1856 – 7 January 1943) was a Serbian-American engineer and futurist best known for his contributions to the design of the modern alternating current (AC) electricity supply system.
highlights: Lifespan: 10 July 1856 (Smiljan, Austrian Empire) – 7 January 1943 (New York City, Aged 86)
Major Inventions: AC induction motor, Tesla coil, wireless power transmission concepts, radio control
War of the Currents: Partnered with George Westinghouse against Thomas Edison's direct current (DC)
Unit of Magnetism: SI derived unit of magnetic flux density 'Tesla' (T) named in his honour

title: Marie Curie — Pioneer of Radioactivity & Double Nobel Laureate
answer: Marie Curie (7 November 1867 – 4 July 1934) was a Polish-French physicist and chemist who conducted pioneering research on radioactivity. She was the first woman to win a Nobel Prize and remains the only person to win Nobel Prizes in two different scientific fields (Physics and Chemistry).
highlights: Lifespan: 7 November 1867 (Warsaw, Poland) – 4 July 1934 (Passy, France, Aged 66)
Nobel Prizes: 1903 Nobel Prize in Physics (Radioactivity) & 1911 Nobel Prize in Chemistry (Radium & Polonium)
Elements Discovered: Polonium (named after Poland) and Radium
Legacy: First female professor at the University of Paris (Sorbonne)

title: Stephen Hawking — Theoretical Physicist & Cosmologist
answer: Stephen Hawking (8 January 1942 – 14 March 2018) was an English theoretical physicist and cosmologist renowned for his work on black hole thermodynamics, gravitational singularities, and his theoretical prediction that black holes emit radiation (Hawking radiation).
highlights: Lifespan: 8 January 1942 (Oxford, England) – 14 March 2018 (Cambridge, England, Aged 76)
Scientific Breakthrough: Hawking Radiation (quantum effects causing black holes to emit thermal radiation)
Bestselling Book: 'A Brief History of Time' (1988) — sold over 25 million copies
Academic Chair: Lucasian Professor of Mathematics at Cambridge University (1979 – 2009)

title: Steve Jobs — Co-Founder & Iconic CEO of Apple Inc.
answer: Steve Jobs (24 February 1955 – 5 October 2011) was an American business magnate, industrial designer, and visionary co-founder and CEO of Apple Inc. He transformed personal computing, music, animated films, and mobile technology.
highlights: Lifespan: 24 February 1955 (San Francisco, CA) – 5 October 2011 (Palo Alto, CA, Aged 56)
Iconic Products: Apple II, Macintosh, iMac, iPod, iPhone, iPad, App Store
Ventures: Co-founder of Apple Inc. (1976), Founder of NeXT, Majority Shareholder & CEO of Pixar Animation Studios
Legacy: Widely recognized as one of the greatest innovators and design visionaries in modern history

title: Bill Gates — Co-Founder of Microsoft & Philanthropist
answer: Bill Gates is 70 years old (born October 28, 1955 in Seattle, Washington). He is an American business magnate, software developer, and philanthropist who co-founded Microsoft Corporation in 1975 with Paul Allen.
highlights: Current Age: 70 years old (Born October 28, 1955 in Seattle, Washington)
Office: Co-founder & former CEO/Chairman of Microsoft; Co-chair of Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation
Key Software: MS-DOS, Microsoft Windows, Microsoft Office
Philanthropy: Donated tens of billions of dollars towards global disease eradication (polio, malaria) and climate tech (Breakthrough Energy)

title: Jeff Bezos — Founder of Amazon & Blue Origin
answer: Jeff Bezos is 62 years old (born January 12, 1964 in Albuquerque, New Mexico). He is an American businessman, media proprietor, and investor who founded Amazon in 1994 and aerospace company Blue Origin in 2000.
highlights: Current Age: 62 years old (Born January 12, 1964 in Albuquerque, NM)
Ventures: Founder & Executive Chairman of Amazon; Founder of Blue Origin; Owner of The Washington Post
Education: Princeton University (Electrical Engineering and Computer Science)
Significance: Pioneered modern e-commerce, cloud computing (AWS), and commercial spaceflight

title: Mark Zuckerberg — Founder & CEO of Meta (Facebook)
answer: Mark Zuckerberg is 42 years old (born May 14, 1984 in White Plains, New York). He is an American business magnate and software engineer who co-founded Facebook (now Meta Platforms) in 2004.
highlights: Current Age: 42 years old (Born May 14, 1984 in White Plains, NY)
Office: Chairman and CEO of Meta Platforms (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Threads, Meta Quest)
Alma Mater: Harvard University (attended)
Philanthropy: Chan Zuckerberg Initiative (pledged 99% of Meta shares over lifetime)

title: Sundar Pichai — CEO of Alphabet & Google
answer: Sundar Pichai is 54 years old (born 10 June 1972 in Madurai, Tamil Nadu, India). He is an Indian-American business executive serving as the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Alphabet Inc. and Google.
highlights: Current Age: 54 years old (Born 10 June 1972 in Madurai, Tamil Nadu)
Office: CEO of Google (since 2015) & Alphabet Inc. (since 2019)
Alma Mater: IIT Kharagpur (B.Tech), Stanford University (MS), Wharton School (MBA)
Padma Bhushan: Awarded in 2022 by the Government of India in Trade and Industry

title: Satya Nadella — Chairman & CEO of Microsoft
answer: Satya Nadella is 59 years old (born 19 August 1967 in Hyderabad, India). He is an Indian-American business executive who has been the CEO of Microsoft since 2014 and Executive Chairman since 2021.
highlights: Current Age: 59 years old (Born 19 August 1967 in Hyderabad, India)
Office: CEO and Executive Chairman of Microsoft
Alma Mater: Manipal Institute of Technology (B.E.), University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee (MS), University of Chicago Booth (MBA)
Padma Bhushan: Awarded in 2022 by the Government of India

title: Sam Altman — CEO of OpenAI & AI Entrepreneur
answer: Sam Altman is 41 years old (born April 22, 1985 in Chicago, Illinois). He is an American entrepreneur, investor, and the Chief Executive Officer of OpenAI, the artificial intelligence research organization behind ChatGPT and GPT models.
highlights: Current Age: 41 years old (Born April 22, 1985 in Chicago, IL)
Offices: CEO of OpenAI; former President of Y Combinator (2014 – 2019)
Key Projects: ChatGPT, GPT-4, DALL-E, Sora, Worldcoin (Tools for Humanity)
Investments: Early investor in Stripe, Reddit, Helion Energy, Retro Biosciences

title: Elon Musk — Tech Entrepreneur & Innovator
answer: Elon Musk is 55 years old (born June 28, 1971 in Pretoria, South Africa). He is the CEO and product architect of Tesla, CEO and Chief Engineer of SpaceX, founder of xAI and Neuralink, and owner/CTO of X (formerly Twitter).
highlights: Current Age: 55 years old (Born June 28, 1971 in Pretoria, South Africa)
Companies: Tesla, SpaceX, xAI, Neuralink, The Boring Company, X Corp
Net Worth: Leading global entrepreneur and business magnate
Education: University of Pennsylvania (Physics and Economics)

title: Donald Trump — President of the United States
answer: Donald Trump is 80 years old (born June 14, 1946 in Queens, New York City). He is an American politician, media personality, and businessman who serves as the 45th and 47th President of the United States.
highlights: Current Age: 80 years old (Born June 14, 1946 in Queens, NY)
Offices: 45th President (2017–2021) and 47th President of the United States
Political Party: Republican Party
Business: The Trump Organization

title: Virat Kohli — Indian International Cricketer
answer: Virat Kohli is 37 years old (born 5 November 1988 in Delhi, India). He is an Indian international cricketer and former all-format captain of the Indian national cricket team.
highlights: Current Age: 37 years old (Born 5 November 1988 in Delhi)
Role: Right-handed top-order batsman
Centuries: 80+ international centuries across Test, ODI, and T20I cricket
Major Honors: 2011 ICC Cricket World Cup, 2013 ICC Champions Trophy, 2024 ICC Men's T20 World Cup, Khel Ratna & Padma Shri

title: MS Dhoni (Mahendra Singh Dhoni) — Cricket Legend
answer: MS Dhoni is 45 years old (born 7 July 1981 in Ranchi, Jharkhand). He is the legendary former captain of the Indian national cricket team who led India to 3 major ICC world titles.
highlights: Current Age: 45 years old (Born 7 July 1981 in Ranchi)
ICC Trophies: 2007 T20 World Cup, 2011 ODI World Cup, 2013 Champions Trophy
IPL Team: Chennai Super Kings (CSK) — 5-time IPL Champion Captain
Padma Bhushan: Awarded in 2018 by the Government of India

title: Sachin Tendulkar — Master Blaster & Bharat Ratna
answer: Sachin Tendulkar is 53 years old (born 24 April 1973 in Mumbai, Maharashtra). Widely acknowledged as one of the greatest batsmen in cricket history, he is the all-time leading run-scorer in international cricket with 100 international centuries.
highlights: Current Age: 53 years old (Born 24 April 1973 in Mumbai)
World Records: Most runs in international cricket (34,357 runs), only player with 100 international centuries
Major Honor: Bharat Ratna (2014) — youngest recipient and first sportsperson
World Cup: 2011 ICC Cricket World Cup Champion with India

title: Rohit Sharma — Captain of the Indian Cricket Team & Hitman
answer: Rohit Sharma is 39 years old (born 30 April 1987 in Bansod, Nagpur, Maharashtra). He is an Indian international cricketer and captain who led India to the 2024 ICC Men's T20 World Cup title and holds the highest individual score in ODI history (264 runs).
highlights: Current Age: 39 years old (Born 30 April 1987 in Nagpur, Maharashtra)
World Record: Highest individual score in One Day Internationals (264 off 173 balls vs Sri Lanka)
ODI Double Centuries: Only player in history to score three ODI double centuries (209, 264, 208*)
Major Honors: 2007 & 2024 T20 World Cup Champion, 5-time IPL Champion Captain (Mumbai Indians)

title: Lionel Messi — Argentine Football Legend
answer: Lionel Messi is 39 years old (born 24 June 1987 in Rosario, Argentina). Widely regarded as one of the greatest football players of all time, he has won a record 8 Ballon d'Or awards and captained Argentina to victory in the 2022 FIFA World Cup.
highlights: Current Age: 39 years old (Born 24 June 1987 in Rosario, Argentina)
Major Trophies: 2022 FIFA World Cup, 2021 & 2024 Copa América, 4 UEFA Champions League titles
Individual Honors: Record 8 Ballon d'Or awards, 6 European Golden Shoes
Clubs: FC Barcelona, Paris Saint-Germain (PSG), Inter Miami CF

title: Cristiano Ronaldo (CR7) — Portuguese Football Icon
answer: Cristiano Ronaldo is 41 years old (born 5 February 1985 in Funchal, Madeira, Portugal). He is the all-time leading international goalscorer in football history and has won 5 Ballon d'Or awards and 5 UEFA Champions League titles.
highlights: Current Age: 41 years old (Born 5 February 1985 in Funchal, Madeira, Portugal)
Records: All-time top international goalscorer (130+ goals) and all-time UEFA Champions League top scorer (140 goals)
Major Honors: 5 Ballon d'Or awards, UEFA Euro 2016 Champion, 5 UEFA Champions League titles
Clubs: Sporting CP, Manchester United, Real Madrid, Juventus, Al Nassr

title: Shah Rukh Khan (SRK) — Actor & Film Producer
answer: Shah Rukh Khan (SRK) is 60 years old (born 2 November 1965 in New Delhi). Referred to in the media as the King of Bollywood and King Khan, he has appeared in more than 90 films.
highlights: Current Age: 60 years old (Born 2 November 1965 in New Delhi)
Production House: Red Chillies Entertainment
Padma Shri: Awarded in 2005 by the Government of India
Notable Works: DDLJ, Swades, Chak De! India, Jawan, Pathaan, Dunki

title: Amitabh Bachchan (Big B) — Shahenshah of Indian Cinema
answer: Amitabh Bachchan is 83 years old (born 11 October 1942 in Prayagraj / Allahabad, Uttar Pradesh). Known as the Shahenshah of Bollywood and Big B, he is widely regarded as one of the greatest and most influential actors in Indian cinema history.
highlights: Current Age: 83 years old (Born 11 October 1942 in Prayagraj, UP)
National Honors: Padma Shri (1984), Padma Bhushan (2001), Padma Vibhushan (2015), Dadasaheb Phalke Award (2018)
Notable Films: Sholay, Deewaar, Zanjeer, Don, Black, Piku, Pink, Kalki 2898 AD
Television: Long-running host of 'Kaun Banega Crorepati' (KBC)
